summary: Hyperion Defi, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The company is selling shares to raise proceeds; terms are not yet finalized as this is preliminary. The filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5). No board recommendation for a special transaction is present. The offering will be priced and closed shortly. No special-situation categorization applies.
